question: Can an independent identity-filler calibration predict the full record law of the existing twist/X preparation while keeping both preparation branches?
obligation: forward realization of the complete preparation instrument, then classical record transport and readout descent

retained: all five original Bool filler functions and ordered labels
both X preparation effects and subnormalized continuations
source.calibration_route: identity filler, Alice X at setting x=1, Bob's existing setting y=0
source.test_route: actual twist filler, all four existing setting pairs

classical_record_channels.herald_effect_label: h=0 for X+, h=1 for X-; not yet a physical record
classical_record_channels.detector_model: Independent classical erasure of ideal instrument record labels, with retention etaA and etaB; no absorptive detector continuation is claimed
classical_record_channels.local_frame_decode: a_decoded=(-1)^(r*x)*a on clicks; no-click stays no-click; Bob unchanged
classical_record_channels.Bell_assignment: Assign each no-click +1 AFTER frame decoding; no record is discarded
transfer_assumptions: Same K and erasure channels in calibration and test modes
Channels independent of analyzer settings and ideal detector labels
Preparation label distribution independent of settings
Frame decoding uses only shared source record and Alice's own setting/record

rivals: Forgetting the herald leaves the Bell readout unchanged
A coherent Z feedback gate or discarding the minus branch is required
Balanced herald marginals certify the record frame
Calibration may be transferred without a common record-channel contract

predictions.prepared_branches: unnormalized Phi+ and Phi- projectors, each trace 1/2
predictions.noncollapse: Identity and inverted K have the same balanced reported-herald marginal but different decoded record laws
predictions.transport_hostile: Calibration K=I versus test K=swap must fail the predicted full-record comparison

acceptance: Exact full continuation and record-law comparison, no parameter fitted to Bell data, plus preservation and deliberate-failure controls
physical_boundary: This is a conditional interface comparison within ordinary quantum mechanics. No physical preparation/readout authority, observed counts, spacelike layout, Born derivation or Marici-versus-QM discriminator is supplied.
stopping_condition: After this comparison, defer physical validation until an independently calibrated apparatus/source record bundle exists; no extra Bell values or synthetic ledgers count as selection evidence.
